get.description: Return application health status. Never exposes internal config.

Health-check endpoint for the processor service.

Returns the resolved principal kind and scopes so callers can confirm
they authenticated as a service identity with the expected privileges.

schema.title: Response Internal Ping Internal Ping Get

post.description:
Authenticate with username and password, create a session, set cookies.

Sets two cookies:
- ``session``: HTTP-only session token.
- ``csrf_token``: Non-HTTP-only CSRF nonce (client JS reads and sends as header).
Revoke the current session and clear the session cookie.
Create a new bearer token.  The raw token is returned exactly once.

get.description:
List all bearer tokens for the authenticated user.

The raw token is never included; only metadata is returned.

delete.description:
Revoke a bearer token by ID.

Returns 404 if the token does not exist or does not belong to the caller.

post.description:
Start a multipart upload and return a signed URL for part 1.

The caller should PUT each part to its signed URL then call
``POST /uploads/multipart/{upload_id}/complete``.

get.description:
Return a signed PUT URL for a specific multipart upload part.

Part numbers must be between 1 and 10,000 (inclusive).
Returns 404 if the upload does not exist or belongs to another user.

post.description:
Finalise a multipart upload.

All parts must have been PUT to their respective signed URLs before
calling this endpoint.  The ``parts`` list must be non-empty.

delete.description: Abort an in-progress multipart upload and release object-store resources.

post.description:
Upload a small audio file directly to the API server (≤ 50 MB).

The API streams the bytes to object storage and returns a COMPLETED upload
record in a single round-trip.  For files larger than 50 MB use the
signed-URL workflow (``POST /uploads/init``) or multipart upload.

Allocate an upload slot and return a short-lived signed PUT URL.

The caller should PUT the file bytes directly to ``upload_url`` before
it expires, then call ``POST /uploads/{upload_id}/complete``.

get.description:
Return the current status of an upload.

Returns 404 if the upload does not exist or does not belong to the caller.

post.description:
Signal that the client has finished uploading.

Transitions the upload status to COMPLETED.  Returns 404 if the upload
does not exist or does not belong to the caller.

get.description:
List artifact summaries for a run.

Returns 404 if the run does not exist or belongs to another caller.
Artifact content is never embedded here; use the download endpoint.

post.description:
Create a run for a completed upload.

Validates upload ownership and completion status, creates a RunRecord and
a JobRecord, then enqueues the job if a queue adapter is configured.

get.description: List all runs owned by the authenticated user.

Return the current state of a run.

Returns 404 if the run does not exist or does not belong to the caller.

Return pipeline events for a run.

Ownership is verified before returning events; returns 404 if the run
does not exist or belongs to another caller.

Note: event persistence is not yet implemented.  This endpoint returns
an empty list until a durable event store is wired in (Stage 5).

post.description:
Request cancellation of a run.

Transitions the run status to CANCELLED.  Returns 404 if the run does
not exist or belongs to another caller.

get.description:
Return artifact metadata.

Artifact content (JSON or Markdown) is not embedded here.
Use ``GET /artifacts/{artifact_id}/download`` to obtain a signed URL.
Returns 404 if the artifact does not exist or belongs to another caller.

Return a short-lived signed download URL for an artifact.

The ``format`` query parameter selects the representation:
- ``json``     — structured JSON artifact content.
- ``markdown`` — human-readable Markdown version (only available when
                 ``has_markdown`` is ``True`` on the artifact).

Returns 404 if the artifact does not exist, belongs to another caller,
or the requested format is not available (e.g. markdown when
``has_markdown=False``).

The raw object key is never included in the response.

ArtifactDownloadResponse.title: ArtifactDownloadResponse
ArtifactDownloadResponse.description:
A short-lived signed download URL for one artifact.

The raw artifact content is accessed through ``download_url``; it is
not embedded in the API response.

ArtifactSummary.title: ArtifactSummary
ArtifactSummary.description:
Metadata about one pipeline artifact.

The artifact content (JSON or Markdown) is not included here.
Use the download endpoint to retrieve a short-lived signed URL.
No object key is exposed.

CompleteMultipartRequest.title: CompleteMultipartRequest
CompleteMultipartRequest.description:
Signals that all parts of a multipart upload have been PUT.

``parts`` is required and must be non-empty.  Each entry must include
the ETag returned by the object store when the part was uploaded.

CompleteUploadRequest.title: CompleteUploadRequest
CompleteUploadRequest.description:
Signals that the client has finished uploading.

``parts`` is required for multipart uploads; omit for single-part.

CreateRunRequest.title: CreateRunRequest
CreateRunRequest.description:
Request to start a processing run for a completed upload.

Provider, model, and prompt selection are server-controlled and must
not appear here.

CreateTokenRequest.title: CreateTokenRequest
CreateTokenRequest.description: Request body for creating a new bearer token.

CreateTokenResponse.title: CreateTokenResponse
CreateTokenResponse.description:
Returned once when a bearer token is created.

The ``token`` field holds the raw value and is never stored server-side.
It will not appear on subsequent list or get calls.

EventResponse.title: EventResponse
EventResponse.description:
A single structured pipeline event.

Raw pipeline text (transcripts, translations, article body) is never
returned here. Use the artifact download endpoint instead.

InitMultipartUploadRequest.title: InitMultipartUploadRequest
InitMultipartUploadRequest.description:
Request to start a multipart upload and receive a signed URL for part 1.

Same extension, content-type, and size constraints as single-part init.
Does not accept ``user_id``, object keys, or provider-related fields.

InitMultipartUploadResponse.title: InitMultipartUploadResponse
InitMultipartUploadResponse.description:
Response from a multipart upload init.

Contains a signed URL for part 1 only; subsequent part URLs are fetched
individually from ``GET /uploads/multipart/{upload_id}/parts/{n}``.
No raw object key is returned.

InitUploadRequest.title: InitUploadRequest
InitUploadRequest.description:
Request to initialise a new single-part upload slot.

Does not accept ``user_id``, object keys, or provider-related fields.

InitUploadResponse.title: InitUploadResponse
InitUploadResponse.description:
Response containing the signed upload URL.

``upload_url`` is a short-lived signed URL for the object store.
No raw object key is returned.

PartUrlResponse.title: PartUrlResponse
PartUrlResponse.description: Signed URL for a specific multipart upload part.

RunResponse.title: RunResponse
RunResponse.description:
Current state of a processing run.

Does not expose ``user_id``, job IDs, object keys, provider details,
or intermediate artifact content.

SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse
SessionResponse.description:
Returned after a successful session login.

Does not include ``user_id`` or any internal identifier.

TokenSummary.title: TokenSummary
TokenSummary.description: Summary of a bearer token (raw value is never returned here).

UploadPartInfo.title: UploadPartInfo
UploadPartInfo.description: One completed part of a multipart upload.

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
Current state of an upload record.

No object key is returned; the server resolves storage location
from ``upload_id``.
